_comment: Item definitions. See game/world/items.py for the fields. 'use' entries are script statements (story/api.py).

ration_pack.name: Ration Pack
ration_pack.desc: Pressed algae protein and whatever hydroponics managed this week. Filling, at least.

nutrient_paste.name: Nutrient Paste
nutrient_paste.desc: Grey. Technically complete nutrition. Nobody has ever asked for seconds.
nutrient_paste.use_text: You swallow the paste without tasting it, which is the trick.

fresh_greens.name: Fresh Greens
fresh_greens.desc: Real leaves, grown under real lamps. On Tethys this is a luxury.
fresh_greens.use_text: Crisp, green and alive. It helps.

coffee_bulb.name: Coffee Bulb
coffee_bulb.desc: A squeeze bulb of something dark and hot. Calling it coffee is generous.

stim.name: Stim Injector
stim.desc: Medical stimulant. Keeps you sharp and upright long after you should be neither.
stim.use_text: Your pulse climbs. The tiredness steps back.

sedative.name: Sedative
sedative.desc: A mild sleep aid from the medbay. Take it lying down.

medkit.name: Medkit
medkit.desc: Sealant foam, dermal patches, a little of everything.

synth_whiskey.name: Synth Whiskey
synth_whiskey.desc: Distilled in somebody's locker. A currency in its own right out here.
synth_whiskey.use_text: It burns all the way down.

spare_parts.name: Spare Parts
spare_parts.desc: Couplings, seals and regulator boards. Fit one at a system console to restore integrity.

scrap_metal.name: Scrap Metal
scrap_metal.desc: Feedstock for the fabricator: two of these become one set of spare parts.

fuel_cell.name: Fuel Cell
fuel_cell.desc: A deuterium-helium charge for the reactor. Each one keeps the lights on for about a day.

ice_core.name: Ice Core
ice_core.desc: A cylinder of ancient ice. The deeper cores have fine purple threads in them.

seed_stock.name: Seed Stock
seed_stock.desc: Vacuum-sealed seed for the grow beds.

pump_seal.name: Pump Seal
pump_seal.desc: A reinforced seal for the main reclamation pump. The old one has been weeping for months.

multitool.name: Multitool
multitool.desc: Driver, cutter, probe and pry bar in one worn handle.

diag_scanner.name: Diagnostic Scanner
diag_scanner.desc: Reads fault codes out of anything with a data port.

med_scanner.name: Med Scanner
med_scanner.desc: Pulse, oxygen, cortisol and three things you had forgotten you could measure.

stun_baton.name: Stun Baton
stun_baton.desc: Security issue. People tend to listen when you are holding one.

thermal_suit.name: Thermal Suit
thermal_suit.desc: Heated undersuit and shell. Without one the dig will kill you slowly.

respirator.name: Respirator
respirator.desc: A rebreather with its own scrubber. Bad air stops being your problem.

tool_belt.name: Tool Belt
tool_belt.desc: Loops, pouches and clips. You can carry a lot more hanging off this.

lucky_coin.name: Driller's Coin
lucky_coin.desc: A token pressed from the first core ever pulled at Ithaca. Tuck swears by his.

keycard_sec.name: Security Keycard
keycard_sec.desc: Opens the brig and the security locker.

dex_key.name: Quartermaster's Key
dex_key.desc: An old-fashioned physical key. Dex does not trust anything that can be reprogrammed.

magpie_key.name: Magpie Start Key
magpie_key.desc: Ignition interlock for the shuttle Magpie.

audit_datapad.name: Audit Datapad
audit_datapad.desc: Your Combine-issue datapad: crew locator, station telemetry and a blank report waiting for a verdict.

cargo_manifest.name: Doctored Manifest
cargo_manifest.desc: Two columns: what the stores received, and what Dex logged. The difference is a shuttle-load, and a margin note reads 'Magpie - night cycle'.

field_notes.name: Lin's Field Notes
field_notes.desc: Page after page of waveforms. In the margins: 'it repeats', then 'it does NOT repeat', then, underlined twice, 'it answers'.

station_charter.name: Station Charter
station_charter.desc: The founding charter of Ithaca Station. Clause 9: a majority of resident crew may refuse decommissioning if the station is self-sustaining.

combine_orders.name: Sealed Combine Orders
combine_orders.desc: Decrypted traffic for the tug's captain: 'Retrieval team to secure SUBJECT ICE. Audit is cover. Crew to be relocated regardless of findings.'

signal_amplifier.name: Amplifier Core
signal_amplifier.desc: The phase-locked heart of a deep space transceiver. There is exactly one on the station. Pip needs it for the comms array; Lin needs it to hear the ice.

artifact_shard.name: Artifact Shard
artifact_shard.desc: A sliver of something that is not ice and not stone. It is very slightly warm, and it hums when you are not listening.

mining_charge.name: Mining Charge
mining_charge.desc: Shaped demolition charge. Two of them would bring down a tunnel for good.
